title: Mentalism
motionSummary: The engraved eye opens, blinks and follows attention; celestial interiors turn while a light travels the architectural spiral.

title: Correspondence
motionSummary: Mirrored stair lights answer one another; the central compass and two vanishing-point stars turn within the original architecture.

title: Vibration
motionSummary: The two tuning-fork tines quiver in opposition; painted wave fronts breathe and luminous vibration moves out across the rings.

title: Polarity
motionSummary: Opposed crescent surfaces catch travelling light, two orbital pearls turn in contrary directions and the central compass holds their shared axis.

title: Rhythm
motionSummary: The actual painted pendulum swings from its pin; small orbiting clock interiors turn and sequential gold arcs mark a silent visual rhythm.

title: Cause and Effect
motionSummary: A phased ripple passes through the five painted dominoes; solar and compass interiors rotate while light follows the chain of consequence.

title: Gender / Creative Modes
motionSummary: Organic veins breathe against precise geometric edges; leaf interiors sway while the central red seed and outer pearls turn.
